external.name: kimi [OPTIONS] [PROMPT]
external.description: Main CLI entry point. Runs interactive shell by default, or print/acp/wire modes with flags.

external.name: kimi info
external.params: Subcommands for version, config, session info
external.description: Display information about Kimi CLI configuration and sessions.

external.name: kimi mcp
external.description: Manage MCP server configurations.

external.name: kimi acp
external.description: Run Kimi CLI as ACP server over stdio for IDE integrations.

external.name: kimi term
external.description: Run Toad TUI backed by Kimi CLI ACP server.

external.name: ACP Protocol (stdio)
external.params: JSON-RPC messages: initialize, new_session, prompt, cancel, load_session, list_sessions, set_session_model
external.description: Agent Communication Protocol for IDE integrations like Cursor. Provides session management, prompting, and model selection over stdio.

external.name: Wire Protocol (stdio)
external.params: JSON messages: TurnBegin, StepBegin, ContentPart, ToolCall, ToolResult, ApprovalRequest, etc.
external.description: Streaming protocol for external integrations. Read user prompts from stdin, write Wire events to stdout.

external.name: KIMI_API_KEY
external.description: Override API key for Kimi provider.

external.name: KIMI_BASE_URL
external.description: Override base URL for Kimi API.

external.name: KIMI_MODEL_NAME
external.description: Override model name for Kimi provider.

external.name: KIMI_CLI_NO_AUTO_UPDATE
external.description: Disables automatic update checks. Set by Nix flake wrapper since Nix handles updates.

external.name: nix build .#kimi-cli
external.description: Build kimi-cli using Nix flake. Produces reproducible build with Python 3.13 and ripgrep bundled.

external.name: nix run .#kimi-cli
external.description: Run kimi-cli directly via Nix without installing. Useful for trying out or one-off usage.

external.name: ~/.kimi/config.toml
external.params: TOML config with providers, models, loop_control, services
external.description: Main configuration file. Stores LLM provider credentials, model definitions, and runtime settings.

external.name: ~/.kimi/mcp.json
external.params: MCP config JSON with mcpServers map
external.description: Global MCP server configuration file.

external.name: ~/.kimi/sessions/<work_dir_hash>/<session_id>/
external.description: Session storage directory. Contains conversation history and wire recording.

external.name: AGENTS.md
external.description: Project documentation injected into agent system prompt as KIMI_AGENTS_MD.

external.name: Agent YAML spec
external.params: name, extend, tools, exclude_tools, subagents, system_prompt_path, system_prompt_args
external.description: Agent specification files (agent.yaml) defining tools, prompts, and subagents.

external.name: SKILL.md
external.description: Skill definition files in ~/.kimi/skills/ directories. Registered as slash commands.

external.name: tests_ai/scripts/run.py [tests_dir]
external.params: tests_dir: path to directory containing test_*.md files (default: tests_ai)
external.description: Runs AI-driven audits using Kimi CLI agents. Executes main.yaml agent which spawns workers for each test file, then parses report.json and emits pytest-style PASSED/FAILED results with colored summary.

external.name: test_*.md (AI test specs)
external.params: Markdown with # Test Name, ## Case Name sections, each with **Scope** and **Requirements** subsections
external.description: AI test specification files in tests_ai/. Defines invariants to audit in the codebase. Worker agents read these and report pass/fail per case.

external.name: tests_ai/report.json
external.params: JSON array: [{file, name, cases: [{name, pass: bool}]}]
external.description: Output file generated by main agent after audit. Contains pass/fail results for each test case. Parsed by run.py for final output.

external.name: .kimi/prompts/*.md
external.params: Markdown files with workflow instructions in Chinese
external.description: Project-local prompt templates for developer workflows. Loaded by developers to guide Kimi CLI through release, PR, changelog, and documentation tasks.

internal.name: KimiCLI.create(session, config, model_name, ...)
internal.params: session: Session, config: Config|Path|None, model_name: str|None, thinking: bool|None, yolo: bool, agent_file: Path|None, mcp_configs: list, ...
internal.description: Factory method to create KimiCLI instance. Loads config, creates LLM, loads agent, restores context.

internal.name: KimiSoul.run(user_input)
internal.params: user_input: str | list[ContentPart]
internal.description: Main agent loop entry. Handles slash commands or runs agent turn with tool calls until completion.

internal.name: run_soul(soul, user_input, ui_loop_fn, cancel_event)
internal.params: soul: Soul, user_input: str|list, ui_loop_fn: UILoopFn, cancel_event: asyncio.Event, wire_file: Path|None
internal.description: Connects soul to UI via Wire. Runs soul and UI loop concurrently, handles cancellation.

internal.name: wire_send(msg)
internal.params: msg: WireMessage (Event | Request)
internal.description: Send message from soul to UI over current Wire. Used by all soul output operations.

internal.name: Wire.ui_side(merge: bool) -> WireUISide
internal.params: merge: bool - Whether to merge Wire messages as much as possible
internal.description: Factory method to create a new UI-side subscriber to the Wire. Returns a WireUISide that receives messages via BroadcastQueue subscription. Multiple UI sides can subscribe to the same Wire.

internal.name: BroadcastQueue.subscribe() -> Queue[T]
internal.params: None
internal.description: Create a new subscription queue that receives all published items. Used by Wire for SPMC message distribution.

internal.name: BroadcastQueue.publish(item: T)
internal.params: item: T - The item to publish to all subscribers
internal.description: Publish an item to all subscription queues. Used by WireSoulSide to broadcast messages.

internal.name: KimiToolset.load_tools(tool_paths, dependencies)
internal.params: tool_paths: list[str] like 'module:ClassName', dependencies: dict[type, Any]
internal.description: Load callable tools by import path with dependency injection for Runtime, Session, Approval, etc.

internal.name: KimiToolset.load_mcp_tools(mcp_configs, runtime)
internal.params: mcp_configs: list[MCPConfig], runtime: Runtime, in_background: bool
internal.description: Connect to MCP servers and load their tools. Runs in background by default.

internal.name: Approval.request(sender, action, description, display)
internal.params: sender: str, action: str, description: str, display: list[DisplayBlock]|None
internal.description: Request user approval for an action. Returns True if approved. Called by tools.

internal.name: Context.checkpoint(add_user_message)
internal.params: add_user_message: bool
internal.description: Create a checkpoint in conversation history for D-Mail time travel feature.

internal.name: Context.revert_to(checkpoint_id)
internal.params: checkpoint_id: int
internal.description: Revert context to previous checkpoint. Used by D-Mail feature to undo actions.

internal.name: TurnBegin
internal.params: user_input: str | list[ContentPart]
internal.description: Wire event indicating start of a new agent turn.

internal.name: StepBegin
internal.params: n: int (step number)
internal.description: Wire event indicating start of a new step within a turn.

internal.name: ContentPart (TextPart, ThinkPart, ImageURLPart, ...)
internal.params: Various content fields
internal.description: Wire events for streaming LLM output content.

internal.name: ToolResult
internal.params: tool_call_id: str, return_value: ToolReturnValue
internal.description: Wire event with tool execution result.

internal.name: ApprovalRequest
internal.params: id: str, tool_call_id: str, sender: str, action: str, description: str, display: list
internal.description: Wire request for user approval. UI must resolve with approve/reject.

internal.name: SubagentEvent
internal.params: task_tool_call_id: str, event: Event
internal.description: Wire event wrapping events from a subagent spawned by Task tool.

internal.name: load_agent(agent_file, runtime, mcp_configs)
internal.params: agent_file: Path, runtime: Runtime, mcp_configs: list
internal.description: Load agent from YAML spec. Loads system prompt, tools, and subagents.

internal.name: Runtime.create(config, llm, session, yolo, skills_dir)
internal.params: config: Config, llm: LLM|None, session: Session, yolo: bool, skills_dir: Path|None
internal.description: Create Runtime with environment detection, skills discovery, and builtin args setup.

internal.name: SlashCommandRegistry.command()
internal.params: name: str, aliases: list[str]
internal.description: Decorator to register slash commands for soul or shell level.

internal.name: kimi_sdk.generate(chat_provider, system_prompt, tools, history, on_message_part?)
internal.params: chat_provider: Kimi, system_prompt: str, tools: list[Tool], history: list[Message], on_message_part: Callable[[StreamedMessagePart], None] | None
internal.description: (kimi-sdk) Async function for chat completion. Creates completion stream, merges message parts into Message with optional TokenUsage. Optional streaming callback for real-time output.

internal.name: kimi_sdk.step(chat_provider, system_prompt, toolset, history)
internal.params: chat_provider: Kimi, system_prompt: str, toolset: Toolset, history: list[Message]
internal.description: (kimi-sdk) Async function for tool-calling step. Layers tool dispatch over generate(), returns StepResult with message and tool_results() awaitable. Used for building agent loops.
